figures.caption: 圖：學務處旁的失物招領櫃
figures.description: 學務處門口旁有一個三層的鐵架，架上堆滿了失物：十幾個顏色不同的水壺、好幾件隨便摺疊、疊成一堆的運動外套、一個裝滿各式耳機的小籃子。架子下方有一個水桶，插滿雨傘和輕便雨衣。很多東西上積了一層灰。架子旁的牆上貼著公告：「本月底仍無人認領的物品將捐出」。一名學生經過時只看了一眼，就匆匆走開。

questions.stem: 提示：許多學校都設有失物招領處，但撿到的物品常常一放就是好幾個月，始終沒有人來認領。請根據下圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中失物招領櫃的情形；第二段說明你認為這麼多失物無人認領的原因，並分享一次你自己或同學遺失物品的經驗。

1.explanation_zh: 第一段只描述圖中的失物招領櫃；第二段有兩個任務：無人認領的原因，以及一次遺失物品的經驗。原因要有兩個以上，經驗要寫出掉了什麼、在哪裡掉、怎麼找、結果如何，最好讓經驗印證你提出的原因，而不是兩件不相干的事。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中失物招領櫃的情形
並分享一次你自己或同學遺失物品的經驗
1.strategy_zh: 圖中的積灰與「月底將捐出」公告，可以當作「很久沒人來領」的證據，接到第二段的原因。
hints: 第一段：依架上、架下、牆上、路人的順序描述
第二段：先列原因，再用一次經驗說明其中一個原因
結尾可以寫經驗帶來的習慣改變，或給學校的一個建議

moves.zh: 描述圖中失物招領櫃的情形
說明你認為這麼多失物無人認領的原因
分享一次你自己或同學遺失物品的經驗

content.focus_zh: 第一段要寫出失物的種類與數量、積灰、捐出公告、學生匆匆走過等細節；第二段要有至少兩個原因，並分享一次具體的遺失經驗（掉了什麼、怎麼找、結果如何），經驗最好和原因互相呼應。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段由架上到架下、再到公告與路過的學生，空間順序清楚；第二段先寫原因、再用經驗印證，最後提出改善方法或心得，轉承語要清楚標出原因與經驗的分界。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在式（There are …、is covered with），敘述經驗用過去式與過去完成式（had seen）；被動語態（will be given away、be claimed）要寫對。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 物品名稱（water bottle、jacket、umbrella、earphones）與「認領、捐出」（claim、donate、give away）要用對，避免只用 things、stuff。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows the lost and found shelf next to the school office. It is full of things that students have left behind. On the shelves, there are more than ten water bottles in different colors and a messy pile of sports jackets. Below them, a bucket is filled with umbrellas and raincoats, and a small basket holds many earphones. Many of these items are covered with dust. A notice on the wall says that everything will be given away at the end of the month. However, a student walking by only glances at the pile and hurries away.
I think there are two main reasons why so many things are never claimed. First, most of these items are cheap, so students would rather buy new ones than spend time looking for the old ones. Second, many students do not even know where the lost and found is. For example, last year I lost my jacket after PE class. I searched my classroom and the playground, but I could not find it. Two weeks later, a classmate told me that she had seen a jacket like mine on the shelf near the office. When I went there, it was hanging right in front of me. As a result, I now write my name on everything I bring to school. In short, students should take better care of their things and check the lost and found more often.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：失物招領櫃上有哪些東西、積灰與捐出公告，以及路過學生的反應

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述完整，原因有兩項，經驗具體且印證第二個原因（內容 4）；兩段各有主題句，列舉與因果轉承清楚（組織 4）；被動語態、過去完成式與 would rather 正確（文法句構 4）；用字正確但以常用字為主（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Next to the school office, the lost and found shelf has turned into a small museum of forgetfulness. Its three levels are crowded with more than a dozen water bottles, sports jackets folded carelessly on top of one another, and a basket overflowing with earphones of every brand. Beneath the shelf, a bucket holds so many umbrellas and plastic raincoats that it looks like a souvenir of every rainy day this semester. A thin layer of dust on most of the items suggests that their owners stopped looking for them long ago. Although a notice warns that unclaimed items will be donated at the end of the month, the student passing by in the picture barely glances at the pile before hurrying off to class, as if it had nothing to do with him.
In my view, the pile keeps growing not because students are careless but because the system is easy to ignore. To begin with, most lost items are cheap and easy to replace; when a new water bottle costs less than a movie ticket, few students will spend a break searching for an old one. Furthermore, the lost and found is usually tucked away in a corner of the office, a place many students would rather avoid. I learned how this happens during my first year of senior high school. One afternoon, I left my favorite jacket, a birthday gift from my aunt, on the bleachers after a basketball game. For days I searched every classroom on my floor, assuming that someone had taken it. Only when a classmate mentioned the shelf did I check there, and the jacket was hanging in plain sight, slightly dusty but perfectly fine. That moment changed my habits: I now label my belongings and check the shelf whenever something goes missing. It also made me realize that the school could do more. For instance, the student association could post photos of found items online every Friday, so owners would know exactly where to go. All in all, with a little effort from both sides, fewer treasures would end up being given away.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：把失物招領櫃比喻成「健忘博物館」，依架上、架下、積灰、公告、路人的順序寫出細節
paragraphs.topic_sentence: Next to the school office, the lost and found shelf has turned into a small museum of forgetfulness.

paragraphs.function_zh: 原因＋經驗：主張問題出在制度而非學生，兩個原因後用找外套的經驗印證，再由個人習慣延伸到學校可以做的事
paragraphs.topic_sentence: In my view, the pile keeps growing not because students are careless but because the system is easy to ignore.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述細膩有推論，原因有新觀點（制度而非學生），經驗具體並延伸出給學校的建議（內容 5）；描述依空間順序，第二段由原因、經驗到建議層層推進（組織 5）；not because … but because、so … that、同位語與一次倒裝運用正確（文法句構 5）；用字精確（tucked away、in plain sight、belongings），仍以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以 a small museum of forgetfulness 開場，由架上、架下到灰塵、公告與路過的學生，空間順序清楚；第二段兩個原因、外套失而復得的經驗與改善建議都有，倒裝句 Only when…did I、過去完成式、被動語態運用自如，字彙豐富。組織扣一分：主題句說 not because students are careless but because the system is easy to ignore，但第一個理由（東西便宜、不值得找）講的是學生的取捨而不是制度；另外 tucked away in a corner of the office 和第一段 Next to the school office（圖中櫃子在學務處門口旁）不一致，assuming that someone had taken it 卻去各班教室找也略不合邏輯。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫到水壺、外套、雨傘雨衣、耳機、積灰、捐出公告與匆匆走過的學生；第二段兩個原因（便宜、不知道招領處在哪）與外套遺失的經驗互相呼應，結尾提出建議，回應每項要求。全文無語言錯誤，過去完成式 had seen、被動 are covered／will be given away 用得對。小瑕疵：Below them…, and a small basket holds many earphones 容易讓人以為耳機籃也在架子下方（圖中在架上）；things 出現三次，字彙偏基本。

top.comment_zh: 第一段由架上、架下寫到積灰、公告與匆匆走過的學生，空間順序清楚且有創意（a small museum of forgetfulness）；第二段提出兩個原因，再用外套遺失又找到的完整經驗印證，最後提出改善方法。句型多變、倒裝（Only when … did I check）正確，用字精準，沒有錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段把水壺、外套、耳機籃、雨傘桶、灰塵、公告與路過學生都寫到；第二段有兩個原因與一次具體的遺失經驗（外套、兩週後被同學告知），並以改善建議收尾，完整回應三項要求。文法與拼字正確，但句型偏簡單，things 重複三次；告示寫成 everything will be given away，與圖中「月底仍無人認領者」略有出入。

issues_zh: 圖中的招領櫃只畫了 7 個水壺，也看不到灰塵，但題目的圖說與兩篇範文都寫「十幾個水壺」（more than a dozen／more than ten）與積灰；只看圖的考生數不出十幾個。建議把圖上的水壺補到至少 10 個，並畫出灰塵，或把圖說改成「好幾個水壺」。
